Kanto Slow Journey - Pokemon walking sprites and derived icons
Repository: https://github.com/PMDCollab/SpriteCollab
Project: https://sprites.pmdcollab.org/
Pinned repository revision: e875450099750eaf6f356079a5e5ab87232d39e1
Source file per Pokemon: sprite/NNNN/Walk-Anim.png, AnimData.xml and credits.txt.
Conversion: directional rows reordered, walk poses sampled and aligned into 64 x 64 cells. Icons use one forward pose.
The source repository publishes CC BY-NC 4.0 terms for community submissions and includes original Chunsoft sprites with separate/unspecified rights. Preserve the asset-specific credits below.
Pokemon and related characters belong to the respective rights holders.
Submission policy: https://github.com/PMDCollab/SpriteCollab/blob/master/README.md
